originalEntry.title: 5-minute New York travel promo
originalEntry.author: LinearUncle
originalEntry.description: A roughly 5-minute Chinese-language New York travel promo aimed at Singaporeans, with free stock footage and music Opus found itself and an edge-tts voiceover.
originalEntry.description_zh: 约 5 分钟的中文纽约旅游宣传片，面向新加坡游客，免费素材和配乐由 Opus 自己找，edge-tts 配音。
originalEntry.prompt: 给我制作一个介绍纽约的视频，视频素材和背景音全部找商用免费的平台,  配音请使用edge-tts，选择男音，字幕和声音都是中文，时长５分钟左右，这个视频将用来吸引新加坡人去纽约旅游
originalEntry.prompt_en: Make me a video introducing New York. Find all the footage and background audio on platforms that are free for commercial use. For the voiceover use edge-tts with a male voice. Subtitles and voice are both in Chinese, about 5 minutes long. This video will be used to attract Singaporeans to travel to New York
